deskyard device list: list the signed-in CLIs

Usage: deskyard [-c COMPUTER] device list [OPTIONS]

Lists the CLI credentials (signed-in devices) of your account, or of another
one (admin); * marks this CLI's own.

Options:
  --account USER       another account's devices (admin)
  --json               print JSON instead of text
  --server NAME        the server to manage (see `deskyard server list`);
                       default: the server -c SERVER/COMPUTER names, else the
                       default server

Prints: a table ID NAME SIGNED-IN LAST-USED; with --json the API's
  [Credential]

Examples:
  deskyard device list
  deskyard device list --account anna

Where: on this machine, talking to the server
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage error; the server's refusal (403 for what your account may not do) is an error
